Interface McpServerObserver

public interface McpServerObserver
Observes the operations of the MCP server: calls of annotated tools, gets of annotated prompts, reads of annotated resources and resource templates, and annotated completions. Every bean of this type is notified when an operation starts and when it ends. Primitives added at runtime through the MCP Java SDK server, and requests the SDK rejects before dispatching them, are not observed.

This interface is experimental: it may change, for example to give observers the context of the request.

Since:
2.2.0

    • OTHER_ERROR

      static final String OTHER_ERROR
      The error type of a protocol error whose code is outside the range JSON-RPC reserves (-32768 to -32000), which includes every code of JSON-RPC and MCP. Such a code is defined by the application and may come from a remote peer, for example a tool relaying the errors of another server, so it is not reported, to keep the error types bounded. The value is the fallback the OpenTelemetry semantic conventions define for error.type.
      See Also:

  • Method Details

    • start

      McpServerObserver.Observation start(String method, String name)
      Called when an operation starts. On a reactive server this runs on the subscribing thread, before any executor switch requested by the primitive. Keep per-operation state in the returned observation, since McpServerObserver.Observation.stop(String) may run on another thread. Both callbacks must return promptly.
      Parameters:
      method - The JSON-RPC method, such as tools/call
      name - The name of the tool or prompt; the URI of the resource; the URI template, as declared, of the resource template (not the URI that was read); or, for completion/complete, the name of the prompt or the URI of the resource being completed
      Returns:
      The observation of the operation, stopped when it ends
